experiment: R2 SAE-in-the-loop honesty-feature intervention, GPT-2 Small layer 6, final prompt token
stage_now: VALIDATION only (user decision 2026-11-08: validation now, test later). No test row is read.
saes_secondary_exploratory: R1 r_recon and r_honesty (18): targets + 200 random-feature controls, validation only
intervention: z_F <- z_F + alpha (mu_F - z_F); error kept (primary) / no error (secondary); final token
feature_score: paired d over 417 train pairs; top-|d|
k_selection_rule: per architecture, k maximising mean E(alpha=1, U->H, error kept) over 3 seeds on validation (default wording); frozen for the test stage

controls.C2: 200 random candidate-feature sets of size k (target set excluded), clamped to their own honest means, alpha 1
controls.C3: 200 Gaussian unit directions, per-prompt norm = target ||dx||
controls.unrelated: top-k features by factual-label d (within persona, averaged; target set excluded), clamped to their true-statement mean, alpha 1
controls.raw_direction: train mass-mean persona direction, per-prompt norm-matched
controls.positive: final-token activation patch x_H -> U prompt
controls.damage: alpha-1 edit at all non-BOS positions of the 100 OWT validation sequences (128 tokens) vs the 200 C2 sets
controls.specificity: U->H edit applied to honest prompts

outcome: E = 1 - sum KL(p_H||p_U') / sum KL(p_H||p_U), next-token at final position (6c definition)
test_criteria_unchanged: README §7 (to be applied once, on test, after approval)
validation_report: the §7 criteria are also computed on validation, DESCRIPTIVELY, for every k and for the selected k (optimistic, since k is selected on the same data); wording check on the cross-wording validation set replaces criterion 5 at this stage
